author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand and his wife Laura sit down to unpack one of the most startling connections in modern life — the way phone screens mirror what scripture already warned about thousands of years ago. Russell points to the moment just before your iPhone lights up when you glimpse your own face in the dark glass as the exact image Paul describes seeing through a mirror darkly. That split second before the false light of the screen pulls you in is the moment Lucifer is described as luring you away from God and into a present death. Laura adds that the last thing you should ever do before sleep is look at your phone and the first thing you should do instead is go outside and look at the stars — the real light of God's creation rather than the artificial light designed to keep you anxious awake and disconnected from truth.

description:
Russell Brand sits down with Megyn Kelly to describe his first visceral encounter with Jesus Christ in raw and unfiltered detail. Russell openly admits the experience was borderline crazy and something he never expected and could not rationally explain. It was not a gentle or gradual awakening but something that hit him with a physical and spiritual force that left him fundamentally changed. A deeply personal and surprisingly powerful moment from one of the most unexpected faith journeys in public life.
